name: VerseSofts AI Order Insights for WooCommerce
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
VerseSofts AI Order Insights for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce orders into actionable business intelligence using AI. Get instant insights on customer value, personalized upsell opportunities, and loyalty recommendations—all automatically generated when orders are placed.

🏢 About VerseSofts

VerseSofts is a WordPress & WooCommerce-focused agency specializing in custom plugin development, performance optimization, and scalable product solutions. We create tools that help store owners automate workflows, enhance customer experience, and grow their business.

Visit our WordPress.org profile to see all our plugins.

🚀 Key Features

  • AI-Powered Order Analysis – Automatically analyze orders using Google Gemini or OpenAI
  • Customer Value Assessment – Identify high-value customers and repeat purchase patterns
  • Smart Upsell Recommendations – Get 2 specific product suggestions based on order contents
  • Personalized Support Notes – AI-generated warm messages mentioning customer’s specific items
  • Loyalty Strategy – Receive discount code or freebie recommendations to boost retention
  • Manual Trigger – Generate insights on-demand for any order with one click
  • Dual AI Provider Support – Choose between Google Gemini or OpenAI
  • HPOS Compatible – Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

🎯 How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the plugin
  2. Configure AI Provider – Enter your Gemini or OpenAI API key in WooCommerce > AI Order Insights settings
  3. Automatic Analysis – When an order status changes to “Processing”, AI analyzes it automatically
  4. View Insights – Check the “AI Order Insights” meta box on any order page
  5. Manual Trigger – Click “Generate Insights Now” to analyze any order on-demand

🔐 Third-Party Services & Privacy

This plugin requires the use of third-party AI services to provide order analysis functionality.

1. Google Gemini (by Google)
* Purpose: Performs natural language analysis of order data to generate insights.
* Data Sent: Order items (names and quantities), order total, and customer first name. No sensitive financial data or full addresses are sent.
* When: Data is sent when an order status changes to “Processing” or when manually triggered by an admin.
* Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

2. OpenAI (by OpenAI)
* Purpose: Alternative AI provider for order analysis.
* Data Sent: Order items (names and quantities), order total, and customer first name.
* When: Data is sent when an order status changes to “Processing” or when manually triggered by an admin.
* Links: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

AI insights are saved locally as WooCommerce order metadata on your server.

Support

Need help? Visit our WordPress.org Support Forum.

sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “VerseSofts AI Order Insights”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > AI Order Insights
  5. Enter your Gemini or OpenAI API key
  6. Save settings and you’re done!
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for AI services?

Both Google Gemini and OpenAI offer free tiers. Gemini’s free tier is generous and suitable for most small to medium stores. Check their pricing pages for details.

Is my customer data safe?

Only essential non-sensitive order data (items, total, first name) is sent to the AI provider. No credit card information, full addresses, or passwords are ever transmitted.
